theorems.name: Submission.iwl_imc_tau_measure_representation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k), IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, X ω = tauAction k M θ ξ ω) → IsMeasureRepresentation X ((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) (fun x => θ x • ξ x)
